_comment: Known defects on current code, per profile. A fault or invariant
listed here is expected to fail; the run reports it as XFAIL and
stays green. If it starts passing the run reports XPASS and FAILS,
so the entry is removed and the issue closed. Every entry names the
issue that tracks the defect. Optional max_recovery_seconds and
max_stall_seconds override the default bounds for a fault.
For faults the expectation covers the stall during the window only;
failing to recover after the window, or a harness error injecting
the fault, always fails the run.
Profiles differ in window length, so a defect that trips the stall
bound in a 60s window (pr, nightly) may not in a 20s one (smoke).

server_teardown_vs_silent_peer.issue: https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/sigul-docker-k8s/pull/8 (patch 06 bounds this teardown; unpatched, the child blocks forever - the production deadlock). Remove after rebasing on #8.

sigul-bridge: no CLOSE-WAIT sockets left.issue: https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/sigul-docker-k8s/pull/8 (bridge leaks one CLOSE-WAIT socket per failed server-side handshake, and main's connect-based compose healthcheck triggers one every probe). Remove after rebasing on #8.

sigul-bridge: no zombie processes.issue: https://github.com/lfreleng-actions/sigul-docker-k8s/pull/8 (main's connect-based compose healthcheck leaves a zombie per probe that hangs on a full backlog: 67 in a 4-minute smoke run locally; #8 replaces it with a listen-state check). Remove after rebasing on #8.
